en-US.promotionalText: A calm space to talk, keep a private journal, understand relationships and take one small step. Continue your saved records across iPhone and web with your Buer account.
en-US.whatsNew:
A refreshed Buer Within, with the latest features from our web experience.

• A quieter paper-inspired interface, blue-teal Doudoulong and native iOS navigation and sheets.
• Sign in with Apple or Google to continue your journals, conversations, growth records, manuals and people across the app and web.
• Private people profiles and relationship manuals, with clearer reading sections and control over the context AI may use.
• 10 free completed AI replies each day. Failed requests do not use your allowance.
• Updated layouts and screenshots for iPhone Duo.
en-US.description:
A little clarity. One conversation away.

Some days, you need space to think before you need an answer. Buer Within is your AI growth companion, Doudoulong: a calm place to talk through a question, understand your situation and choose one next step.

START WITH WHAT MATTERS NOW
Ask about a decision, relationship, work pattern or feeling. Write your own question or choose a suggested starting point. You decide whether permitted growth-profile context accompanies the conversation.

BUILD A GROWTH PROFILE
Explore 12 reflection questions across mind, body, connection and meaning, and vocation. Add personal stories, goals, preferences and constraints. Choose one small action, define progress and return to record what happened. Edit, export or clear your records.

A PRIVATE JOURNAL AND PEOPLE SPACE
Keep a journal of the moments that matter. Add private profiles for people in your life and explore communication, decisions, rhythm, repair and practical actions in relationship manuals. These are prompts for observation, not judgments about another person. Obtain permission before entering someone else's birth information.

CONTINUE ACROSS APP AND WEB
Local reflection works without signing in. Optional Apple or Google sign-in syncs saved journals, conversations, growth records, manuals and people to the same Buer account. Use the same sign-in method on both platforms. Signed-in records sync over HTTPS and are not end-to-end encrypted. Export or delete your records and delete your account from Me > My account.

YOU CONTROL AI CONTEXT
AI requests go to our server and DeepSeek after consent. Birth details are not automatically attached. Permitted reflections, stories and relevant journal or relationship excerpts are used only within the sources you authorize for the requested feature. Your own writing may contain personal information; choose what you share. Syncing a record does not itself grant permission to use it for AI. Optional usage analytics are off by default and exclude journal text, messages and birth details.

AN OPTIONAL SELF-KNOWLEDGE LENS
Generate a Human Design-based reading on your device and compare its ideas with lived experience. It is an interpretive lens, not a prediction, scientific assessment or definition of your abilities.

FREE AND OPTIONAL PLUS MEMBERSHIP
Receive 10 completed AI replies per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC. A completed AI action guide counts as one reply. Failed requests do not use your allowance. Local reflection, stories, readings and action records require no subscription. Optional monthly or annual Plus removes the daily AI reply cap; reasonable rate limits remain.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in Apple subscription settings.

The four-domain reflection is inspired by Dan Koe's HUMAN 3.0 framework; it is not an official or validated psychological assessment. AI can make mistakes. Buer Within supports reflection and does not provide medical, psychological, legal or financial advice.

Privacy: https://buer.wonderelian.com/privacy.html
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

zh-Hans.promotionalText: 聊清困惑，写下私密日记，理解身边的关系，再选择一个小行动。登录不二账号，让对话、成长档案与说明书在 App 和网页之间接续。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
把网页上的新体验，带到你的 iPhone。

• 全新纸感界面、蓝绿色豆豆龙，以及 iOS 原生导航与弹出页。
• 支持 Apple 或 Google 登录，日记、对话、成长档案、说明书与人物资料跨端同步。
• 私密人物档案与相处说明书，分类阅读更清晰，AI 参考范围由你决定。
• 每日免费完整 AI 回复调整为 10 条，失败请求不扣额度。
• 更新 iPhone Duo 布局适配与商店截图。
zh-Hans.description:
把此刻的困惑，慢慢说清楚。

有时，你需要的不是立刻得到答案，而是一点把事情想清楚的空间。不二见己是你的 AI 成长伙伴豆豆龙：陪你聊眼前的困惑，理解自己的处境，选择一个愿意尝试的下一步。

从眼前最在意的事开始
聊一个决定、一段关系、一种工作模式，或一个还说不清的感受。预设问题会轮换，也可以直接写下自己的问题。由你选择是否带上已授权的成长档案背景。

慢慢建立自己的成长档案
围绕心智、身体、关系与意义、事业，回答 12 个基础问题。补充经历、转折、目标、偏好与现实限制。选择一个小行动，写下进展标准和回顾日期，再记录真实的变化。内容可以编辑、导出或清空。

私密日记与身边的人
记录日常感受与重要时刻，为身边的人建立私密档案。从沟通、决策、节奏、修复和行动等章节阅读相处说明书，用真实相处验证观察，而不是给对方下定义。录入他人的出生资料前，请先取得本人允许。

让 App 与网页接续
本地自我探索无需登录。选择 Apple 或 Google 登录后，已保存的日记、对话、成长档案、说明书与人物资料会同步到同一个不二账号；两端请使用相同登录方式。账号同步使用 HTTPS 传输，不是端到端加密。你可以导出或删除记录，并在「我的 → 我的账号」删除账号。

分享什么，由你决定
AI 请求只会在你同意后发送至我们的服务器及 DeepSeek，不会自动附带出生资料。访谈、经历、日记与关系对话的相关摘录，只在你为对应功能授权的参考范围内使用；你主动写入的个人信息也会随内容发送。同步内容不会自动授权 AI 参考。可选的使用统计默认关闭，不包含日记正文、对话内容或出生资料。

可选的自我观察视角
在设备上生成人类图解读，再结合真实经历验证其中的想法。它只是可选的解释性视角，不预测未来，也不是科学评估，更不会定义你的能力。

免费使用与可选会员
每天可免费获得 10 条完整 AI 回复，每日 UTC 00:00（北京时间上午 8:00）重置。完整 AI 行动指南计为 1 条，失败请求不扣额度。访谈、经历、说明书与行动记录无需订阅。月度或年度会员不设每日 AI 回复条数上限，保留合理的频率限制。

订阅通过 Apple 账户收取费用并自动续期，除非在当前订阅期结束前至少 24 小时取消。可在 Apple 订阅设置中管理或取消，价格以购买页面为准。

四领域访谈参考 Dan Koe 的 HUMAN 3.0 框架，不代表官方测评，也不是经过验证的心理测量。AI 可能出错。本产品用于自我反思，不提供医疗、心理、法律或财务建议。
